I'll start by looking up the Nusretiye Clock Tower. From what I find, it's also known as the Tophane Clock Tower. It's located in the Tophane neighborhood of Istanbul, specifically in the Beyoğlu district. That's in the European part of Istanbul, right next to the Nusretiye Mosque. So, that's a good start. Both the clock tower and the mosque are in Istanbul.

Now, for the Eski Imaret Mosque. I search for its location and find that it's also in Istanbul. Specifically, it's in the Historical Peninsula area. That's another part of Istanbul, but still within the city. So, both landmarks are in Istanbul.

Wait, but I should make sure I'm not confusing the neighborhoods. The Nusretiye Clock Tower is in Tophane, which is part of Beyoğlu, while the Eski Imaret Mosque is in the Historical Peninsula, which is a different area but still within Istanbul. So, both are indeed in Istanbul, just different neighborhoods.

I think I've got it. Both landmarks are located in Istanbul, Turkey. I don't see any conflicting information, so I can confidently say that the city is Istanbul.
